{{Quote|My blasted fool of a daughter&mdash;or is it my son?&mdash;has gotten into trouble. One of them has a gambling problem and has fallen afoul of some hoodlums. If these ruthless crooks aren't paid, one of them will get hurt. Would you go and save whichever one of them got into this mess?|Sidoras Bey to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Silaras Bey''' was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] offspring of [[Sidoras Bey]], both of whom lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sidoras, who would often have a hard time remembering if Silaras was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] or a woman, tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with rescuing Silaras after she got in trouble with some hooligans.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempArtisan.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Silaras Bey, including five non-Human depictions deemed non-canon in Legends]]
Silaras Bey was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Silaras Bey spawned under the generic "artisan" template, her appearance was randomized under one of six possible depictions. She could appear as a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], or [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] of the male gender, or as a Human female. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Silaras as Sidoras' offspring, this article assumes that the Human female depiction is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
